name: Ajoko
tagline: A live record-keeper for rotating savings circles (ajo). It never holds anyone's money.
highlights: Whole member lifecycle, onboarding to disputes; the first real circle completed with zero defaults.
Staff back-office: monitoring, role-based access, support inbox, disputes console, audit log, announcements.
Also an agreement step, receipts and host succession; that first circle had 7 members on daily rounds.
Closed a 25-alert security pass, and self-hosted the font so the ₦ sign and Yoruba characters render correctly.

name: Marcplaats
tagline: A hyperlocal photo-spotting app (PWA), in continuous delivery since May 2026.
highlights: Business rules enforced in the database: row-level security, rate-limit triggers, CHECK constraints.
GPS-first upload with map-pin fallback, Serwist PWA, Sentry; a failing Playwright test before every feature.
Admin activity feed, push and email engagement, and ongoing security hardening.

name: Retail storefront for a Lagos phone shop
tagline: A 733-product catalogue built around WhatsApp orders, with an owner panel.
highlights: Workers, D1 and R2 store with an owner self-service panel; each WhatsApp tap counted as a conversion.
Verified its Google Business Profile; homepage indexed and 774 pages discovered in Search Console.
Brand redesign with colours sampled from the shop's own signage, plus a share card for links.

name: Webinar and events platform
tagline: A Nigeria-first webinar and events platform with paid tickets, built for a client.
highlights: Gated join links, Paystack ticketing, reminders by email, push and SMS, host analytics and recurring series.
Designed its visual system from scratch; security passes took Dependabot alerts from 21 to 0.
A QR-code flyer feature so hosts can promote an event offline.

name: Studio agents
tagline: Agents that run parts of my own studio: one writes code, one watches every live site, one operates a computer.
highlights: Coding agent: plans, executes, verifies in a sandbox behind a hard safety gate; a human merges each PR.
Watchman that checks every live site and files issues; computer-use agent with a coded kill switch.
The computer-use agent's policy is enforced in code, not in its prompt: kill switch, deny and confirm rules, and a full action journal.

name: House of Faridah
tagline: A multi-brand site for a Nigerian interior-design and construction company, with its own CMS.
highlights: Two sub-brands in one app, an admin portal and a portfolio CMS with galleries and watermarking.
Image weight cut from 61 MB to 8.5 MB; the Interiors page is interactive in 2–9 s, down from 27–90+ s.
Per-route SEO tags, sitemap and robots fixed; dependency and security patches; a Node 22 deploy pipeline on GitHub Pages.
A copy-paste 'add a project' workflow so the client can publish new work.

name: HealthBrew
tagline: A marketplace platform for healthcare professionals. Not launched; the code was archived in 2026.
highlights: Built the whole platform: admin, backend API and data layer, with a Playwright e2e suite on self-hosted CI.
Designed professional-license verification (about 50 files, 9,800 lines) behind a feature flag.
Privacy-safe user exposure helpers and a role-upgrade review flow.

name: Dreamy AI
tagline: A multi-agent platform that writes full-length novels from a concept. Handed to the client in 2026; on hold.
highlights: 7-agent pipeline (concept → graph → blueprint → write → critique → polish) producing 80k+ word books.
Neo4j knowledge graph for story continuity; a multi-critic/reviser quality system with ML quality prediction.
Full observability stack (Prometheus, Grafana, Sentry) across a containerised, multi-service deployment.

name: Local-SEO agency website (NL)
tagline: Google indexing from 3 of 14 pages to 11 of 13.
highlights: Three-page Astro and Tailwind site with tag management and Consent Mode v2; the Astro 7 upgrade took 37 Dependabot alerts to 0.
Indexing fixes, a pricing and FAQ page, IndexNow, Search Console and Bing submission, and AI-crawler allow-listing on Cloudflare: 3 of 14 pages indexed on 21 Sep 2026, 11 of 13 on 26 Sep.

name: AI Visibility Check
tagline: Measures who AI assistants cite for a business, then ships the fixes.
highlights: Asks ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity and Claude a business's own customer questions, through the client's own logged-in AI apps in a real browser, and reports who they cite.
Delivered round one in full to the first client, a Dutch agency: report, indexing fixes, a pricing and FAQ page, IndexNow, search-engine submission and AI-crawler allow-listing.

name: SEO specialist's brand site (NL)
tagline: Rebuilt the site and integrated a nine-route redesign.
highlights: Own-domain email with SPF, DKIM and DMARC (mail-tester 10/10), tag management, and the phone number surfaced sitewide.
Astro 5 to 7 security upgrades and build-time sitemap dates.

name: Conference-venue SEO (NL)
tagline: 20 pages fixed and 6 translated inside a booking CMS.
highlights: Fixed titles, descriptions and H1s on 20 pages, corrected noindex tags and broken links, linked three orphaned pages, translated six pages to English and added a landing page, all inside the CMS with no code repo.
Reported each round to the client as a flattened PDF status report.

name: Doll-shop Shopify store (NL)
tagline: Reopened the store; card contrast from 1.1:1 to 8.36:1.
highlights: Theme republish, navigation and dead-link fixes, with checkout and cart verified end to end.
Traced a shop-wide overlay setting that made product cards unreadable; measured contrast went from 1.1:1 to 8.36:1.

name: Physio-practice directory (NL)
tagline: Proof of concept ranking practices from public map data.
highlights: Data pipeline from a public Google Maps export: deduplicated and filtered 89 listings down to 50 practices for the first city.
Trust-first redesign with rank-badge rows, a methodology page and an accessibility pass; kept out of search until the client picks the next cities.

name: My Record Label
tagline: Catalogue, royalties and artist portal for labels. Not launched.
highlights: Distributor-agnostic royalty ingest with deal-aware reconciliation, recoupment and manager commission.
Artist-scoped catalogue and split sheets (row-level security verified), a fan CRM, smart links and an artist login portal, on its own design system.

name: In-home massage booking marketplace
tagline: Two-sided, with an ops console. Not launched.
highlights: The full booking-to-payout lifecycle, with a payment hold and a safety timeline for each session.
An ops console with a verification queue, dispatch and incident review, and a design system studied against real luxury-hospitality examples.

name: News-reading browser extension (MVP)
tagline: Highlights how a news article is constructed.
highlights: Detect-only, in plain JavaScript with no LLM and no server: all detection runs in the page.
MVP demo and packaged extension delivered to the client for testing on real articles.

name: BetGist
tagline: Betting previews, odds comparison and a public record of settled picks.
highlights: Match previews, odds comparison and a public record page that settles every pick; kept out of search until its own domain is registered.
An internal quantitative model, run as a paper-trading research pipeline.
